summary: Normalizes a floating-point angle in place against +PI and -PI. Values at or below +PI are left unchanged when already at or above -PI, and are wrapped upward by 2*PI when below -PI. Values above +PI are reflected by replacing *this with 2*PI - *this rather than subtracting 2*PI (the difference from its structural twin AngleWrap 00455f90). Uses the +PI constant at 0x0059EFA4 and the 2*PI constant at 0x0059EFA8. Called by CollisionResponseFilter (004584c0).

local_names.this: angle value (single float) normalized in place

operations.description: Compares *this against +PI (flt_59EFA4, 3.1415927) and branches to the reflection path when it is strictly greater
On the less-or-equal path, checks whether *this is below -PI (flt_59EFA4 negated, -3.1415927)
When *this < -PI, wraps upward by adding 2*PI (flt_59EFA8, 6.2831855) into this+0x0
When *this > +PI, replaces this+0x0 with 2*PI - *this (flt_59EFA8 minus the current value), reflecting rather than subtracting
Returns void; the normalized angle remains in this+0x0
Invoked by CollisionResponseFilter (004584c0) to normalize a collision angle before further processing

unresolved: The two PI constants are read from global floats (flt_59EFA4, flt_59EFA8); their write sites are outside this packet

The reflection formula (2*PI - *this) in the greater-than-PI branch differs from the plain 2*PI subtraction in the structural twin 00455f90; the semantic intent (wrap vs reflect) is not resolved by this packet alone
